title: Zesty Smoky Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: Smoky and festive Uruguayan dish featuring filo pastry and a nimono-simmer, cooked in a claypot to perfection, this satvik-friendly recipe is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the claypot by brushing it with olive oil.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the filo pastry sheets and cut them into circles.
Spoon the beef mixture onto one half of each pastry circle.
Fold the pastry in half to form a triangle or square shape and press the edges together to seal.
Place the empanadas in the prepared claypot and brush with olive oil.
Pour the beef broth into the claypot and cover with a lid.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
